title: Seven Winters and One Short Post
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与社会·灾害防范与安全）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与社会·灾害防范与安全）　|　核心词汇：fence　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 my grandfather ① built a fence that no neighbour in the lane would have measured, and he said the building was the whole of the winter. The ② fence, meaning the barrier itself and not the wall, ran seven winters and stayed unmeasured in the book; a fence, he said, is the only thing in a lane that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ fence in that lane had the same short post beside it, and the ④ fence at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the garden and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fence, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; my grandfather said the measuring is the part that fills seven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fence was the whole of the matter, meaning the line and not the barrier. The ⑥ fence, meaning the line and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; fence, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a barrier and a line. He said the line is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ fence had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short post. The ⑧ fence of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in January, was one lane and seven winters of measuring; fence, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fence I remember is the one measured in the plan, which closed in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the lane. A ⑩ fence, my mother said in 1970, is the only one that improves by being measured; every fence, she said, is a line that has agreed to look like a barrier. She said the line was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 栅栏；围栏（指巷子里每一道旁边的那一道）
B. n. 围栏（指那一道本身，与墙相对）
C. 固定搭配：build a fence 修一道围栏
D. n. 围栏（指留给园子的那一道）
E. n. 围栏（抽象总称，指一条巷子的围挡之事）
F. n. 围栏（指图纸上写到、被量过的那一道）
G. n. 界限；分界线（指一件事里人人都等却无人量过的那样东西）
H. n. 界限（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人量过的那样东西）

items.q: built a fence that no neighbour in the lane would have measured

answers.why: build a fence 意为“修一道围栏”，1959 年祖父修了一道巷子里没有一位邻居肯量过的围栏。
fence 意为“围栏”，指那一道本身而不是墙，它经过了七个冬天而在簿子上没有尺寸。
fence 意为“围栏”，指巷子里每一道旁边的那一道，每一道旁边都有同一根短短的柱子。
fence 意为“围栏”，指留给园子的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fence 意为“界限、分界线”，指一件事里人人都等却无人量过的那样东西，叔叔说这条界限就是那件事的全部。
fence 意为“界限”，指人人都等却无人量过的那样东西而不是那一道围栏，是事情里人人都等、却无人量过的东西。
fence 意为“围栏”，指图纸上写到、被量过的那一道，到 1966 年这一道成了图纸里的一行。
fence 意为“围栏”，祖父一月写道，整件事的围挡之事是一条巷子和七个冬天的量过。
fence 意为“围栏”，我记得的是图纸上量过的那一道，1968 年结束了，至今仍被说成巷子里最安静的一道。
fence 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，一道围栏是唯一会因为被好好量过而变得更好的东西。
